title: Settings
description: Read-only view of the local configuration EXEGEZIS actually uses. Nothing here is editable yet, except access and searches.

general.dataSourceValue: Artifacts on disk only. No database, no demo data.
general.cloudWorkspace: Your account, in the cloud: only your data.

environment.note: Environments are derived from each run's target URL; loopback addresses are reported as Local.

models.callsValue: Exactly one. No retries, no repair, no agent loop.
models.roleValue: Writes a test plan. Never decides a verdict; its confidence is never evidence.
models.note: Credentials are checked for presence only. Their value is never read into the UI.

security.beforeProviderValue: Symptom and page structure are redacted for secrets and personal data.
security.evidenceValue: Run artifacts are redacted and hashed at capture; the manifest records the redaction status of each file.
security.capturedValue: Rendered only in a sandboxed frame with scripts disabled (CSP sandbox).
security.artifactAccessValue: Only files inside discovered run directories, read-only.

permissions.body: There are no accounts, roles or permissions: the UI runs locally for the user who started it. Authentication and access control are not implemented.

searchPage.title: Searches
searchPage.description: Cost limit, model and your templates. Saved in <dir></dir>, outside runs/.

form.costHelp: The cost is estimated before calling the AI; if it exceeds the limit nothing is sent and you are asked to approve it. It also applies to “Suggest related terms”.
form.name: Name

errors.limit: The limit must be a number of USD between 0.01 and 100.
errors.templateEmpty: A template needs terms, a meaning description, or both.

sitesPage.title: Verified sites
sitesPage.description: To check more than {pages} pages of a site, prove it is yours, as in Google Search Console: with a meta tag on its home page or a TXT record in its DNS.
sitesPage.count: {count, plural, =0 {No sites} one {# site} other {# sites}}
sitesPage.none: You have not added any site yet.
sitesPage.howMeta: Option 1: put this tag inside the <head> of the home page:
sitesPage.howDns: Option 2: add this TXT record to the DNS of {host}:
sitesPage.notFound: Neither the meta tag nor the TXT record was found. If you just added them, wait a few minutes (DNS can take a while) and check again.
sitesPage.nowVerified: Site verified: you can now check more than {pages} pages.
sitesPage.errorSite: Write a domain or an address, for example your-site.com.
sitesPage.errorOrigin: The request did not come from EXEGEZIS. Reload the page.
